sections.indications_and_usage: Use Hand Sanitizer to help reduce bacteria that potentially can cause disease. For use when soap and water are not available.
sections.dosage_and_administration: Directions Place enough product on hands to cover all surfaces. Rub hands together until dry. Supervise children under 6 years of age when using this product to avoid swallowing.
sections.warnings_and_cautions: Warnings For external use only. Flammable. Keep away from heat or flame
